name: Malta
description: Malta from the temples older than the pyramids to the Phoenicians, the Knights of St John, the Great Siege, Britain, independence and the EU.

checkpoints.name: The temple builders
checkpoints.note: The temples of Malta were built from about 3600 BCE. Phoenicians, Romans and Arabs came, and then the Normans.

checkpoints.name: The Knights
checkpoints.note: The Knights of St John held Malta from 1530, beat off the Great Siege of 1565 and built Valletta.

checkpoints.name: British Malta
checkpoints.note: Britain made Malta a naval base. The island held out under bombing from 1940 to 1942.

checkpoints.name: Independent Malta
checkpoints.note: Malta became independent in 1964, a republic in 1974 and a member of the EU in 2004.
